leads.title: Curacao Criminal Code - Wetboek van Strafrecht / Kodigo Penal (2011)
leads.documents: Prohibits unfair discrimination and incitement to hatred and violence on grounds including 'heterosexual or homosexual orientation'; defines discrimination and penalties for LGBTQ legal protection status.
leads.detail: Cited in-text as enacted in 2011, Article 1:221 definition, Articles 2:61 and 2:62 penalties fines to one year imprisonment. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Supreme Court of the Netherlands - 12 July 2024 same-sex marriage ruling for Curacao
leads.documents: Rules same-sex marriage is legal in Curacao, upholding Appeals Court decision barring discrimination based on sexual orientation; core marriage-equality legal status.
leads.detail: Cited in-text as 'On 12 July 2024, the Supreme Court of the Netherlands ruled that same-sex marriage is legal in Curacao'. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Appeals Court decision on same-sex marriage discrimination (pre-2024, upheld by Supreme Court)
leads.documents: Prior appellate ruling barring discrimination based on sexual orientation regarding same-sex marriage, later upheld 12 July 2024; documents rights machinery/enforcement.
leads.detail: Cited in-text as 'upholding the Appeals Court decision barring discrimination based on sexual orientation'. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: European Court of Human Rights - Oliari and Others v. Italy (August 2015)
leads.documents: Rules it is discriminatory to provide no legal recognition to same-sex couples; noted as having jurisprudence over Curacao for recognition obligation.
leads.detail: Cited in-text as 'In August 2015, in the case of Oliari and Others v. Italy'. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Estates of Curacao - 2017 proposal for limited rights for same-sex couples
leads.documents: Legislative attempt to grant same-sex couples some limited rights; documents parliamentary rights machinery.
leads.detail: Cited in-text as 'In 2017, a proposal to grant same-sex couples some limited rights was introduced to the Estates of Curacao'. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: 2018-2019 Marriage Equality Bill by FOKO Curacao, Equality Curacao and Curacao Gay Pro
leads.documents: Civil-society bill to allow same-sex couples to marry in Curacao, handed to Vice President of Parliament Giselle McWilliam Sept 2018, submitted to Estates 4 June 2019, withdrawn Sept 2020 for lack of support.
leads.detail: Cited in-text with dates Sept 2018 handover, 4 June 2019 submission, Sept 2020 withdrawal. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: April 2015 agreement of representatives of all four constituent countries of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
leads.documents: Kingdom-level political agreement that same-sex couples should have equal rights throughout the Kingdom, including Curacao.
leads.detail: Cited in-text as 'In April 2015, representatives of all four constituent countries agreed'. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Kingdom of the Netherlands recognition rule for marriages from Netherlands and Caribbean Netherlands
leads.documents: Documents pre-2024 status where Curacao must recognize same-sex marriages registered in the Netherlands as well as in Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, and Saba as valid, but could not perform them locally.
leads.detail: Cited in-text as Kingdom obligation paragraph. No URL visible in provided text.
